lines.3: This was bad. I had no idea silence could be this painful.
lines.4: Talking was still better than this.
lines.8: 「You're not in the martial-arts club or the student council.」
lines.9: 「And you're not her relative like I am... so why?」
lines.10: 「Because I'm always the one going over to talk to her.」
lines.11: 「Keep that up for more than a year and of course you get close.」
lines.14: 「I chose Ryuumeikan in the first place because I liked how seriously it takes mental discipline.」
lines.15: 「It's coed, but it has an old-fashioned, hard-edged spirit.」
lines.17: 「You probably picked it just because it's close.」
lines.20: 「...It happened right after I entered Ryuumeikan.」
lines.21: 「On my way home from school, I saw a guide dog at a traffic light.」
lines.23: 「Then two idiots came along and pressed a cigarette against the dog.」
lines.25: 「The owner couldn't tell what they were doing... and guide dogs are trained not to make much noise, so the dog simply endured it.」
lines.26: 「I guess that's what they found so amusing.」
lines.28: 「It had been a long time since I'd seen such unmistakable, sickening malice.」
lines.29: 「So I stormed over to confront them.」
lines.31: 「When I laid into them, those men actually tried to hit me.」
lines.32: 「You... really keep ending up in situations like that.」
lines.33: 「Iron-senpai was the one who caught the man's raised hand.」
lines.34: 「First-year. What you just did was very maidenly. I liked it.」
lines.37: As usual, her very existence was practically cheating.
lines.38: 「The dog's burn wasn't serious, and once everything was settled, Iron-senpai said this to me.」
lines.39: 「You did well to firmly confront two men. You've got spirit.」
lines.40: 「I'm proud to have a junior like you.」
lines.41: 「I was captivated by her strength and her smile.」
lines.43: 「That's how we got to know each other. I admired her, so I kept going to see her, and here we are.」
lines.44: 「Unlike you, Iron-senpai never went soft. She kept walking the path she believed was right.」
lines.45: 「That just makes me admire her even more.」
lines.47: 「But what would you have done if Otome hadn't been there that day?」
lines.53: 「This is going to turn into another fight.」
lines.55: 「Anyway, now you understand why I admire Iron-senpai.」
lines.57: 「...Otome would probably be disappointed if we came down from this tower and she found us still fighting.」
lines.61: 「We think differently. Arguing isn't going to solve that.」
lines.62: 「All it does is wear us both down.」
lines.63: 「So instead of constantly clashing and causing trouble for everyone around us...」
lines.64: 「Why don't we both bite our tongues and just be ordinary acquaintances?」
lines.65: 「...That's just the kind of rotten idea I'd expect from you.」
lines.66: 「But I don't want Iron-senpai or anyone else worrying because of us either...」
lines.67: 「So even when I want to snap at you, I'll try to hold it in.」
lines.69: 「Then let's call this a truce for now.」
lines.71: ...A reconciliation with both our hearts still cold.
lines.72: I had complicated feelings about it.
lines.75: 「The view's beautiful... Why don't you stop looking down and take a look?」
lines.83: After that, we stayed silent the whole time.
lines.86: 「Well, we can't just make up all at once, but we agreed to meet each other halfway.」
lines.89: 「A chance to start was all you needed.」
lines.90: 「I'm glad I got to act like a proper senior.」
lines.92: 「All right! Now we can enjoy the rest of the day without worrying!」
lines.93: Otome was full of energy right to the very end.
